[{"insert":"Aerobic Push Pull

This piece keeps you moving on a 12 minute clock, alternating a machine with a push and a pull so no single area burns out. Settle into a steady pace on the bike or row, then hit the push ups and single arm dumbbell work without chasing failure. Take short breaks as needed, but keep the rest minimal.   The goal is smooth, continuous output for the full 12 minutes, not sprint and stall.
"}]
